svg.title: Entering an invoice yourself
svg.text: New invoice, and Use as invoice on a job file. M6 said it lands in To pay once it has a contractor and a total, but fields save as you leave them, so it would jump mid-typing.
A. It's a To review invoice, and you approve it
Same page as every invoice: fields save as you go, Approve moves it to To pay. One tap, no second partner, no staff email.
B. A form that saves on Add invoice
Nothing saves until Add invoice; then it lands in To pay with a contractor and a total, or in To review without them.
A: the row is made in To review when the first file drops or the first field saves, so the upload has an invoice to belong to.
A: a half-entered invoice you walk away from waits in To review; Not an invoice clears it.
B: a second way to edit the same fields, and the file needs a draft to upload into before Add invoice is tapped.
Both: a partner's own entry never needs the other partner, and never sends the staff email (M12).
